spans.s:
(इर) श्च्युतिर् r. 1st cl. (श्च्योतति)
1 To sprinkle.
2 To ooze, to drop or distil.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Dropping, flowing.
2 Shed, sprinkled, issued, oozed.
E.
श्च्युत to sprinkle, and क्त aff.

m. (-तः)
Sprinkling, pouring forth, aspersion.
E.
श्च्युत to sprinkle, aff. घञ्; also श्चोत.

mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्)
1 Oozing, flowing, trickling.
2 Shedding.
E.
श्च्युत to ooze, शतृ aff.
